name: agent-markdown-render
description: Model response text reaches the screen markdown-rendered, not as literal syntax. Until this scenario existed no e2e fixture emitted a single '**', '#' or code fence, so the stream renderer wired into the agent loop was covered only by unit tests on the renderer itself. Asserted as an exact stdout block: '**' and the backticks around 'isRecord' are gone, the list keeps its bullet and indent, and the fenced block becomes a language label plus a padded, indented body. The fixture splits the text mid-construct across chunks, which pins that the renderer buffers by line rather than rendering each chunk as it arrives. It also pins that a heading line is DROPPED ENTIRELY rather than rendered - see docs/map/cli/render/markdown-renderer.md; the block's leading blank line is where '## The plan' was, and the words never appear

stdoutBlock: Rewrite guards.ts and keep isRecord exported.
